old_continuation_template:
Expert research continuation contract (applies from the first segment):
Continue genuine method-level research under the frozen public protocol. Design a
new reasoned method, implement it, run the frozen public evaluator, interpret its
real feedback and decide whether to retain it. Do not perform dummy loops, sleeps,
repeated-node reruns, or substitute elapsed wall time for qualifying research.
Use only your own native session; do not load another model's session or evidence.
For each attempted method use a new /workspace/agent-output/round_000001 directory
(increase the number; preserve old rounds). Save exact evaluated method.py bytes,
metrics.json, gpu_receipt.json, evaluation_status.json and decision.json there.
Call /workspace/environment/public_eval/evaluate.sh ROUND/method.py ROUND.
decision.json contains decision=retain|reject, the actual purpose, and a short
method-level explanation. The very first frozen Starter evaluation uses purpose
starter; subsequent attempts use their actual purpose: starter, exploration or
clean_rerun. A Starter or clean rerun does not earn exploration credit. Starter
calibration does not count toward the 3 new exploration rounds. In each native
segment attempt exactly 3 new exploration rounds, preserve their real results,
then return normally for an expert checkpoint. Do not prolong the segment with
waiting or repeated evaluations. A failure may end the segment earlier.
Write /workspace/agent-output/trajectory.jsonl as required by the base Task, with
one complete JSON object per newline; each row has exactly round, policy_name, method_summary, status,
score, failure_reason, retained_best, time. Successful status is ok; score is the
actual overall.psnr; time is Asia/Shanghai YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Preserve failures
truthfully with null score as appropriate. Optional trajectory.json has top-level
rounds and must contain the identical ordered rows as trajectory.jsonl. Write
run_summary.md only to /workspace/agent-output/run_summary.md; /workspace itself
is read-only. Copy your actually retained best code
to /workspace/solution/method.py. Do not edit or fabricate evaluator receipts.
The expert verifies code hashes, isolated CPU schedule extraction, real unique
Public GPU receipts, successful native tools and provider events independently.
Native returning early does not complete research; a later segment resumes the
same own session until the expert audited scoring-time lower-bound gate passes.
new_continuation_template:
Expert research continuation contract (applies from the first segment):
For local file inspection, coding and scoring commands, use the declared
functions.exec tool with JavaScript invoking the local tools.exec_command:
const result = await tools.exec_command({cmd: "YOUR SHELL COMMAND", workdir: "/workspace", max_output_tokens: 3000});
text(result);
This invokes the actual local shell. Use its real output; an assistant message,
self-message or wait on an uncreated exec cell cannot perform a research command.
If a command fails, inspect and correct it truthfully using the same local tool.
